utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — if you can bring the parts list by, I’ll check what’s missing and we can set a drop-off time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m happy to help, but I skimmed the details — can you remind me the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, that’d help — please lay it out a bit clearer, and I’ll keep bringing up the repair drive so it stays on everyone’s radar.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — just send me the time and place, and I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, are we still short on screwdrivers, a cordless drill, and spare nails? If so, I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that’s right — we’re still short on screwdrivers, a cordless drill, and spare nails. Thanks for keeping an eye out too; I’ll pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work well for me. I’ll check the school schedule and let you know what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye. Just let me know what you can spare and I’ll fit the repair drive around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll take a look at the school calendar and get back to you soon with what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Pia — I’ll head to the community center and start sorting the donated parts and labeling the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m on my way to the community center now, Pia, and I’ll get the donated parts sorted and the boxes labeled.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: We’re still on for after lunch — I’m just making sure the loose fence panel and squeaky gate are on the list. If you want, I can try to lay out the plan a bit clearer.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll swing by late and help fill whatever gaps are left.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good — let’s keep it simple and start at the community center. After lunch works for me, and we can sort the rest as we go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Works for me — I’ll come by after lunch and help fill in whatever’s still missing at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a hammer, screwdriver set, and a wrench if that helps. Just tell me what you’re fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a lot — thanks, Gus. I’ll ask around and pass along that you’ve got the basics covered, and I’ll tell you if I hear what else the drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell — just let me know if you hear anything else, and I’ll bring what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I help spread the word, could you confirm the repair drive’s time and location?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep — it starts at 10 a.m. at Quinn’s place. We could still use extra tools, tape, and a few helping hands if you can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ve got it. I’ll pass along the 10 a.m. start at Quinn’s place and mention the extra tools, tape, and helping hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it—I’ll check our supplies and make a quick list of what’s still missing for the repair drive. Tape, gloves, and spare screws would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Tape, gloves, and some spare screws—I can help with those. What else still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: If you’ve got a list, I can keep helping. I’ll check back in and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help a little, but I need to keep it simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s completely fine, Uli — we’ll keep it simple. The repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I can take the rest from here.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate you taking the lead.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still missing the time and location for the repair drive, but I can help figure it out together if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep bringing up the repair drive and repeating the plan so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — that helps. What still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive’s time and location? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help connect everyone, and I’ve got the repair drive details: the window should work before pickup time, and we’ll keep it clear around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you clarify the exact pickup time and where the repair drive is meeting? I want to share the right details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure on the time or location yet, but I can check and let you know. Once I spot it, I’ll pass along the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out too, and if I hear what they still need, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll sort the supplies, then. Can you tell me who’s coming so I can make sure we’ve got enough?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure yet who all’s coming, Mina. If you want, I can help spread the word and see what tools folks might need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d help, Gus. Please spread the word and ask folks what tools they need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s now Sunday at the community center, so we should plan around that change. What would you like to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start by noting the community center for the repair drive, and I’ll keep track of the rest as we go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll note Sunday at the community center, and then we can line up the supplies and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — I’m easy to miss things, so I appreciate any updates on the repair drive. If you hear anything new, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the repair drive starts at 10 a.m. at my place, and we still need extra tools, tape, and a few helping hands. If you can, please spread the word and swing by!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word while I’m out and I’ll swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. See you at 10 a.m. if you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, after lunch sounds good—I’m still a bit scattered, but I’ve got the fence panel and gate parts lined up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Sam — I’ll keep pulling the repair drive stuff together and meet you after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now and I’ll make a quick list of what’s still missing. Tape, gloves, and spare screws would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good—I can help with tape and gloves, and I’ll see what spare screws we can spare. I’ll keep it clear before pickup time and send you an update once I’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — I’ll note tape and gloves as covered, and I’ll wait for your update on the spare screws.
